generated_entry_conditions: Long entry: vol_ratio > 1.3 AND ret_15m > 0 AND trend_strength = abs(ret_15m) / rv_45m > 0.6
Short entry: vol_ratio > 1.3 AND ret_15m < 0 AND trend_strength > 0.6
hypothesis_name: Volatility-Aware Crypto Momentum (from: Internal Note: Volatility-Regime Gated Momentum on ETH Perpe)
one_sentence_idea: Directional persistence in crypto returns is exploitable when conditioned on volatility regime; trend entries only in expanding-volatility regimes.
core_alpha_hypothesis: Directional persistence in crypto returns is exploitable when conditioned on volatility regime; trend entries only in expanding-volatility regimes.
entry_rules: Long entry: vol_ratio > 1.3 AND ret_15m > 0 AND trend_strength = abs(ret_15m) / rv_45m > 0.6
Short entry: vol_ratio > 1.3 AND ret_15m < 0 AND trend_strength > 0.6
exit_rules: Exit on regime transition: vol_ratio < 0.7 (expanding -> contracting)
Time stop: exit after 90 minutes in position
Stop-loss at 2x ATR_45m from entry price
risk_rules: max position risk 1% of equity per trade (default)
position_sizing: size normalized by realized volatility to target 12% annualized portfolio volatility; risk 1% of equity per trade using stop distance 2x ATR_45m
fees_slippage_model: taker 6 bps per side (fees + slippage); maker 1 bp where passive fills are realistic

feature_formulas.rv_45m: std(1m log returns over 45 bars) * sqrt(45)

order_assumptions: market (taker) orders at next 1m bar open after signal; no partial fills modeled; execution latency tolerance >= 1 bar (non-HFT by construction)
baseline_comparisons: randomized-entry baseline with identical exits and sizing
unconditional variant (same rules without the regime/filter condition)
expected_failure_modes: edge is an artifact of survivorship or lookahead bias
signal decays after fees at the target timeframe
regime dependence: works only in trending/high-vol samples
minimum_viable_backtest: Primary: ETH-USDT perpetual futures, 1m-15m bars (ohlcv + volume), over >=3 years including one bear market. Optional robustness: BTC/ETH perpetuals. Compare vs the baseline set (buy-and-hold, randomized-entry, unconditional variant).
walk_forward_validation_plan: Rolling walk-forward: 12-month train / 3-month test, stepped quarterly; require positive OOS expectancy in >=60% of folds.
anti_overfitting_checks: parameter-stability heatmap (edge must not live in one cell)
deflated Sharpe ratio on OOS results
test on assets not used for parameter selection
